name: chrome-title
description: Inflated chrome 3D hero title (react-three-fiber) with a CSS fallback

scripts.build:lib: tsc -b && vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts && esbuild ../vendor/chrome-title/*.js --minify --format=esm --outdir=../vendor/chrome-title --allow-overwrite --log-level=warning && cp public/fonts/unbounded-black.typeface.json public/fonts/rubik-black.typeface.json public/fonts/boorsok.typeface.json ../vendor/chrome-title/ && cp public/fonts/unbounded-900-latin.woff2 public/fonts/unbounded-900-cyrillic.woff2 public/fonts/rubik-900-latin.woff2 public/fonts/rubik-900-cyrillic.woff2 public/fonts/boorsok.woff2 ../fonts/ && cp font-src/OFL-Unbounded.txt font-src/OFL-Rubik.txt ../fonts/
scripts.fonts: node scripts/make-typeface.mjs font-src/Unbounded-Black.ttf public/fonts/unbounded-black.typeface.json && node scripts/make-typeface.mjs font-src/Rubik-Black.ttf public/fonts/rubik-black.typeface.json
